statement: Keep one Claude Code session on the agreed goal: an LLM judges each file edit against the approved design, asks the user when an edit drifts, and recaps where you left off when you come back.
success_criteria: On a real repo, an edit outside the approved design gets a one-line question before it lands
Edits inside the approved design pass with no prompt and no visible delay (under 3 s)
Every verdict (fits, drift, unclear) and its reason is in .mission/meta.jsonl
A new user goes from install to first guarded edit in under 10 minutes
